messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED 1976543210 - elevated latency observed on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Pager: @sara-oncall. Link: https://incident.redwood/1976543210
oliver-sre: paged @sara-oncall. seeing ~3% 5xx and p95 up to 2.1s across g4dn pool
sara-oncall: ack. investigating now. starting rollback of latest canary to limit blast radius
matt-eng: can confirm queue length spike on the g4dn autoscaler. i'll stand by to adjust scaling thresholds if needed
sara-oncall: confirmed affected models: redwood-slim-1, redwood-bert-lmn. region: us-west-2. rollback triggered (canary -> previous). ETA ~2m
incident-bot: deploy rollback triggered by sara-oncall at 1976543225
julia-product: need a quick statuspage initial update for customers — throwing a draft below, please review fast
matt-eng: lgtm, but include what customers might see (errors + slow responses) and mitigation steps
julia-product: ```Initial status (draft):
We are investigating increased latency and intermittent errors for text generation endpoints in us-west-2. Customers may experience slower responses or occasional 5xx errors.
What we are doing: rolling back a recent canary deploy and applying autoscaling adjustments.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when we have new info.
Affected customers: hosted API customers in us-west-2.```
emily-support: can we add suggested customer guidance? e.g., retry with exponential backoff, or pin to another region if possible. i'll draft a short broadcast once we have approved copy
oliver-sre: add note about optional routing to us-east-1 for critical workloads — link to region doc: https://docs.redwood/regions
sara-oncall: rollback finished at 1976543240. error rate down to ~0.8%, p95 down to 340ms. continuing to monitor for regressions
julia-product: updating statuspage draft and sending for signoff to @matt-eng and @sara-oncall. draft below for publishing
julia-product: ```Statuspage publish draft (for public):
1976543210 - Initial update
Summary: We are investigating increased latency and intermittent errors impacting text generation endpoints in US-West-2.
Impact: Some requests may be delayed or return 5xx errors.
Mitigation: We rolled back a recent canary deploy and applied autoscaling adjustments. Metrics are improving.
Next update: In 30 minutes or when we have material changes.
Support: contact support@redwood.ai for urgent issues.```
matt-eng: approved, please include a link to the live incident board in the published note
emily-support: prepping customer broadcast: ```Email template (short):
Subject: Temporary degradation in US-West-2 affecting text generation
Body: We are investigating intermittent latency and errors affecting text generation in US-West-2. We have rolled back a canary deploy and applied mitigations. We will follow up with another update in ~30 minutes. For urgent issues, reply to this email or open a support ticket.```
sara-oncall: monitoring metrics. system looks stable — will post next status update by 10:37Z unless resolved earlier :thumbsup:
incident-bot: STATUSPAGE PUBLISH REQUEST queued by julia-product at 1976543255
oliver-sre: publishing now. i'll push the public update and post a short note to #general to surface to customers who subscribe there
julia-product: published at 1976543265 — public update available: https://status.redwood/incident/1976543210
matt-eng: metrics stable for last 5m. recommending prepare resolved notice but wait 20 minutes to ensure no regression
julia-product: drafting resolved notice template: ```Resolved update (draft):
Status: Resolved
Summary: The incident impacting text generation in US-West-2 has been resolved.
Root cause: Incorrect autoscaler configuration during a canary release caused resource contention in the GPU pool.
Remediation: Reverted the canary, corrected autoscaler config, and added guardrails to prevent similar rollouts.
Follow-up: Full RCA and timeline to be published within 48 hours.```
sara-oncall: handing post-incident monitoring to @oliver-sre for 2 hours. please run the regression checks and watch for recurrence
oliver-sre: ACK. will run the regression suite and coordinate RCA meeting. logging actions to the incident board
julia-product: thanks everyone — i'll prepare the customer-facing postmortem and coordinate account outreach. :rocket:
